paragraphs: Software engineer with 10+ years of professional experience building commerce, subscription, licensing, and authentication systems. Combines Java and Spring backend development with Wolfram Language ERP services and full-stack delivery. Experience owning pricing logic, improving API performance, and integrating payment and identity platforms.
Languages: Java, Wolfram Language, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
Backend: Spring Boot, Spring, REST APIs, MySQL, Tomcat, Gradle
Integrations: Stripe, Google Play subscriptions, JWT
Engineering: API profiling, batch processing, unit and performance-regression testing, Git, Jira, Codex

blocks.title: Wolfram Research | Software Engineer / Web Application Developer
bullets: Assumed primary development ownership of the ERP pricing engine, implementing product and market-specific pricing, subscription-renewal rules, and price-change reporting across currencies.
Improved site-user management API performance by resolving subscription-site lookup failures, reducing dependencies, and optimizing repeated per-user work.
Built ERP-backed site-administration APIs and interfaces in Wolfram Account, including concurrent user uploads, progress feedback, and more reliable access management for large institutional sites.
Integrated Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Alipay through Stripe across online checkout and ERP payment workflows, and added wallet-based billing updates in Wolfram Account.

Modernized the backend API for online purchasing and subscriptions to Java 21, Spring Boot 3, and Tomcat 10, including OAuth2/OIDC browser authentication and expanded regression and integration coverage; in testing.
Implemented Android in-app subscriptions across Java services and ERP, supporting Wolfram|Alpha Pro purchases through Google Play and access to subscriptions bought directly from Wolfram.
Built automated execution-time regression checks into the ERP unit-test framework to help detect performance regressions.
Implemented a site-license discovery API for AI clients using domain and IP-based availability checks, product access links, and fallback recommendations.

blocks.title: Health Coach | iPhone Workout Journal | Private external TestFlight beta
bullets: Built an iPhone workout journal with Angular, Ionic, TypeScript, and Capacitor/Swift bridges for Apple Health access and protected on-device storage.

Implemented set logging, history, user-approved progression changes, atomic local saves with recovery, CSV import validation and duplicate prevention, and JSON backup/restore; verified builds and domain/import behavior through automated tests and simulator workflows.

blocks.title: AgentFlow | Project Planning and AI Coordination | In development
bullets: Developed an Angular/TypeScript project workspace with a Node.js server and SQLite persistence for project registration, discovery, planning, and attention tracking.
Implemented portable project-knowledge exports in JSON and Markdown and bounded public-HTTPS repository acquisition, keeping external project source separate from application-owned state.
